_about: Fights you can start in the test room. Each enemy standing in the room has a fight id. 'encounter' is the id in data/battle/encounters.json, 'challenge' is the conversation that plays when Red talks to it (it ends in a Fight? choice), 'yes' is the conversation the Fight! choice leads to (the fight starts when it ends), 'no' is the other answer. A win removes that enemy until the room is loaded again (a flag called defeated_<fight id>); running away leaves it there.
